cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Gracious Command
cards.instruction: Remain warm and appreciative while steadily reducing everyone else’s room to choose.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you for finding reunion venues. We'll use my garden; you've given me exactly the information I needed.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The hall has shelter if it rains.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent catch. I'll hire a gazebo for the garden. Keep the rain plan at the same address, please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll keep the hall reservation as a backup.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're wonderfully thorough. Cancel it, please; two live bookings leave people guessing. Send everyone the garden address.
